name: qkd_ctrl_pc_core_s4-s4-COMMIT
purpose: KVCTRL split 2026-10-16 (Codex-prescribed, no third same-shape retry, no waiver): e1 one HBM root 17,150 sinks at measured insertion 426.8 ps (>300 rule) and e2 plateaued at native_commit_identity -58.453 ps. qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static becomes a wires-parent of three hardened roots: core (scheduler/tags/CDC/observer/drain, ~13.3k hclk sinks est), port (actual ot_qfd_emb_pcport KVW2/RQD64 + its data pin flops, ~2.9k), ECC (actual ot_qfd_kv_landing_ecc, ~0.9k). Every seam output flop-driven; priced edges: native commit +1 hclk (new pin register; SDC moves native_commit_* to the hclk domain), static write data +1 hclk into the port (hidden, column >= 4 edges later), KV read/write 0. s4 (lead 2026-10-16, parallel to core_s1's hold ECO): STRUCTURAL fixes of the two measured core limiters. (1) e_l_v is captured in a pin flop l_v_q (core_s1 routed TT in->reg -30.92; gate textbook 13-level e_l_v -> drain_kv cone): drain_kv counts the ECC landing one hclk edge later (debt held longer, never early; raw e_l_v kept in the activity veto), traffic 0 edges, drain observation <= +1 hclk (already conservative, DRAIN_PIPE). (2) ot_qkd_static_kv_timing write-queue next head: per-entry bank one-hot stored at push + registered wq_rp1, both head candidates read in parallel and the late wr_ok selects last (was wr_ok -> wq_rp+1 -> 4:1 read -> 5:32 decode, 18 levels, ~772 ps): cycle-identical, 0 edges. cycles_added 0 (traffic/data); drain observation +1 hclk.
